svg.title: amp Library view with filter chips and album grid
svg.desc: A mockup of amp's Library view. At the top, a dark-navy inverted Bluetooth button indicating active Bluetooth output. Below, a yellow brutalist block header reads Library. Next, a row of three filter chips: Albums rendered as a dark-navy inversion to indicate it is the currently selected filter, and Artists and Songs as white chips with indigo shadows. A two-column grid of four album tiles follows: Kid A by Radiohead on dark red, Blue by Joni Mitchell on deep navy blue, Illinois by Sufjan Stevens on warm ochre, and Grace by Jeff Buckley on charcoal. Each tile has the brutalist stroke and offset indigo shadow, with the album title and artist name below. At the bottom, a four-tab navigation bar with Library selected as a dark-navy inversion, and Search, Playing, and Queue as white unselected tabs.
